        ed = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        ld = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            p = inst.V_p[k]
            d = inst.V_d[k]

            jp = inst.jobs[p]
            jd = inst.jobs[d]

            px[k] = Float64(jp.point.x)
            py[k] = Float64(jp.point.y)
            pz[k] = Int64(jp.point.z)
            sp[k] = Float64(jp.servt)
            ep[k] = Float64(inst.e[p])
            lp[k] = Float64(inst.l[p])

            dx[k] = Float64(jd.point.x)
            dy[k] = Float64(jd.point.y)
            dz[k] = Int64(jd.point.z)
            sd[k] = Float64(jd.servt)
            ed[k] = Float64(inst.e[d])
            ld[k] = Float64(inst.l[d])
        end

        visited = fill(false, n)
        order = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)

        curr_x = 0.0
        curr_y = 0.0
        curr_z = 0
        curr_time = 0.0

        @inbounds for step in 1:n
            best_k = 1
            best_score = Inf

            for k in 1:n
                if !visited[k]
                    dist_curr_p = sqrt((px[k] - curr_x)^2 + (py[k] - curr_y)^2) + abs(pz[k] - curr_z) * 15.0
                    arr_p = max(curr_time + dist_curr_p, ep[k])
                    lat_p = max(0.0, arr_p - lp[k])

                    dist_p_d = sqrt((dx[k] - px[k])^2 + (dy[k] - py[k])^2) + abs(dz[k] - pz[k]) * 15.0
                    arr_d = max(arr_p + sp[k] + dist_p_d, ed[k])
                    lat_d = max(0.0, arr_d - ld[k])

                    lateness = lat_p + lat_d
                    score = lateness * 10000.0 + arr_d + rand(params.rng) * 1e-3

                    if score < best_score
                        best_score = score
                        best_k = k
                    end
                end
            end

            order[step] = best_k
            visited[best_k] = true

            dist_curr_p = sqrt((px[best_k] - curr_x)^2 + (py[best_k] - curr_y)^2) + abs(pz[best_k] - curr_z) * 15.0
            arr_p = max(curr_time + dist_curr_p, ep[best_k])
            dist_p_d = sqrt((dx[best_k] - px[best_k])^2 + (dy[best_k] - py[best_k])^2) + abs(dz[best_k] - pz[best_k]) * 15.0
            arr_d = max(arr_p + sp[best_k] + dist_p_d, ed[best_k])

            curr_x = dx[best_k]
            curr_y = dy[best_k]
            curr_z = dz[best_k]
            curr_time = arr_d + sd[best_k]
        end

        result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[order[k]])
        end
        return result
    end
end

function llm_candidate_score(inst::InstanceData, params::ParameterData)::Vector{Int64}
    n = inst.n
    if n <= 1
        return Vector{Int64}(inst.V_p)
    end

    px = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    py = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    pz = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    dx = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    dy = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    dz = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    p_serv = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    d_serv = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    pair_slack = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    tw_width = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    dem = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        p = inst.V_p[k]
        d = inst.V_d[k]
        jp = inst.jobs[p]
        jd = inst.jobs[d]

        px[k] = Float64(jp.point.x)
        py[k] = Float64(jp.point.y)
        pz[k] = Int64(jp.point.z)

        dx[k] = Float64(jd.point.x)
        dy[k] = Float64(jd.point.y)
        dz[k] = Int64(jd.point.z)

        p_serv[k] = Float64(jp.servt)
        d_serv[k] = Float64(jd.servt)

        d_pd = sqrt((px[k] - dx[k])^2 + (py[k] - dy[k])^2) + abs(pz[k] - dz[k]) * 10.0
        pair_slack[k] = Float64(inst.l[d]) - Float64(inst.e[p]) - p_serv[k] - d_pd
        tw_width[k] = Float64(inst.l[p]) - Float64(inst.e[p])
        dem[k] = Float64(inst.q[p])
    end

    isolation = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        min1 = Inf
        min2 = Inf
        for m in 1:n
            if m != k
                d_km = sqrt((px[k] - px[m])^2 + (py[k] - py[m])^2) + abs(pz[k] - pz[m]) * 10.0
                if d_km < min1
                    min2 = min1
                    min1 = d_km
                elseif d_km < min2
                    min2 = d_km
                end
            end
        end
        isolation[k] = (min1 + (min2 == Inf ? min1 : min2)) * 0.5
    end

    mode_val = rand(params.rng)

    if mode_val < 0.65
        keys = Vector{Tuple{Float64, Float64, Float64, Float64, Float64}}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            p = inst.V_p[k]
            iso_key = -(isolation[k] + (rand(params.rng) - 0.5) * 0.2 * isolation[k])
            slack_key = pair_slack[k] + (rand(params.rng) - 0.5) * 2.0
            tw_key = tw_width[k]
            dem_key = -dem[k]
            e_key = Float64(inst.e[p])

            keys[k] = (iso_key, slack_key, tw_key, dem_key, e_key)
        end

        perm = sortperm(keys)
        result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[perm[k]])
        end
        return result

    else
        visited = fill(false, n)
        order = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)

        best_start = 1
        best_val = Inf
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            val = pair_slack[k] + rand(params.rng) * 2.0
            if val < best_val
                best_val = val
                best_start = k
            end
        end

        order[1] = best_start
        visited[best_start] = true

        @inbounds for step in 2:n
            prev = order[step - 1]
            p_prev = inst.V_p[prev]
            d_prev = inst.V_d[prev]

            t_comp = max(Float64(inst.e[d_prev]), Float64(inst.e[p_prev]) + p_serv[prev]) + d_serv[prev]

            best_next = 1
            best_cost = Inf

            for m in 1:n
                if !visited[m]
                    d_trans = sqrt((px[m] - dx[prev])^2 + (py[m] - dy[prev])^2) + abs(pz[m] - dz[prev]) * 10.0
                    arr_p = t_comp + d_trans
                    p_m = inst.V_p[m]
                    e_pm = Float64(inst.e[p_m])
                    l_pm = Float64(inst.l[p_m])

                    wait_t = max(0.0, e_pm - arr_p)
                    late_t = max(0.0, arr_p - l_pm)

                    cost = d_trans + 0.5 * wait_t + 100.0 * late_t + rand(params.rng) * 0.1
                    if cost < best_cost
                        best_cost = cost
                        best_next = m
                    end
                end
            end

            order[step] = best_next
            visited[best_next] = true
        end

        result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[order[k]])
        end
        return result
    end
end

function llm_candidate_score(inst::InstanceData, params::ParameterData)::Vector{Int64}
    n = inst.n
    if n <= 1
        return Vector{Int64}(inst.V_p)
    end

    mode_val = rand(params.rng)

    if mode_val < 0.30
        # Strategy 1: Temporal Conflict Density & Resource Bottleneck Ordering
        # Calculate how many other requests overlap in time; prioritize high-conflict, high-demand requests
        overlap = zeros(Float64, n)
        @inbounds for i in 1:n
            p_i = inst.V_p[i]
            d_i = inst.V_d[i]
            ep_i = Float64(inst.e[p_i])
            ld_i = Float64(inst.l[d_i])
            for j in 1:n
                if i != j
                    p_j = inst.V_p[j]
                    d_j = inst.V_d[j]
                    ep_j = Float64(inst.e[p_j])
                    ld_j = Float64(inst.l[d_j])
                    if max(ep_i, ep_j) <= min(ld_i, ld_j)
                        overlap[i] += 1.0
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        keys = Vector{Tuple{Float64, Float64}}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            p = inst.V_p[k]
            d = inst.V_d[k]
            slack = max(1.0, Float64(inst.l[d] - inst.e[p]))
            dem = Float64(inst.q[p])
            score = overlap[k] * 2.0 + (dem * 10.0) / slack + rand(params.rng) * 0.05
            keys[k] = (-score, rand(params.rng))
        end

        perm = sortperm(keys)
        result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[perm[k]])
        end
        return result

    elseif mode_val < 0.60
        # Strategy 2: Polar Angular Sweep within Spatio-Temporal Epochs
        cx = 0.0
        cy = 0.0
        min_e = Inf
        max_e = -Inf
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            p = inst.V_p[k]
            jp = inst.jobs[p]
            cx += Float64(jp.point.x)
            cy += Float64(jp.point.y)
            ep = Float64(inst.e[p])
            if ep < min_e; min_e = ep; end
            if ep > max_e; max_e = ep; end
        end
        cx /= n
        cy /= n
        e_span = max(1.0, max_e - min_e)

        keys = Vector{Tuple{Int64, Int64, Float64, Float64, Float64}}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            p = inst.V_p[k]
            d = inst.V_d[k]
            jp = inst.jobs[p]

            epoch = Int64(floor(3.999 * (Float64(inst.e[p]) - min_e) / e_span))
            p_z = Int64(jp.point.z)
            angle = atan(Float64(jp.point.y) - cy, Float64(jp.point.x) - cx)
            slack = Float64(inst.l[d] - inst.e[p])
            jitter = rand(params.rng) * 1e-4

            keys[k] = (epoch, p_z, angle, slack, jitter)
        end

        perm = sortperm(keys)
        result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[perm[k]])
        end
        return result

    elseif mode_val < 0.85
        # Strategy 3: Joint Capacity-Slack Bottleneck Priority
        keys = Vector{Tuple{Int64, Float64, Float64, Float64, Float64}}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            p = inst.V_p[k]
            d = inst.V_d[k]
            jp = inst.jobs[p]
            jd = inst.jobs[d]

            cross_island = (jp.point.z != jd.point.z) ? 0 : 1
            slack = Float64(inst.l[d] - inst.e[p])
            dem = Float64(inst.q[p])
            earliest = Float64(inst.e[p])
            jitter = rand(params.rng) * 1e-4

            # Prioritize cross-island trips with tight capacity-to-slack ratio
            tightness_ratio = slack / (dem + 1.0)
            keys[k] = (cross_island, tightness_ratio, earliest, -dem, jitter)
        end

        perm = sortperm(keys)
        result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[perm[k]])
        end
        return result

    else
        # Strategy 4: Sequential Forward-Chain with Floor Consistency
        px = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        py = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        pz = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        dx = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        dy = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        dz = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        ep = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        ld = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            p = inst.V_p[k]
            d = inst.V_d[k]
            jp = inst.jobs[p]
            jd = inst.jobs[d]

            px[k] = Float64(jp.point.x)
            py[k] = Float64(jp.point.y)
            pz[k] = Int64(jp.point.z)

            dx[k] = Float64(jd.point.x)
            dy[k] = Float64(jd.point.y)
            dz[k] = Int64(jd.point.z)

            ep[k] = Float64(inst.e[p])
            ld[k] = Float64(inst.l[d])
        end

        visited = fill(false, n)
        order = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)

        # Seed initial request based on earliest pickup time with perturbation
        best_e = Inf
        start_k = 1
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            score = ep[k] + rand(params.rng) * 5.0
            if score < best_e
                best_e = score
                start_k = k
            end
        end

        order[1] = start_k
        visited[start_k] = true

        @inbounds for step in 2:n
            prev = order[step - 1]
            best_k = 1
            best_cost = Inf

            for k in 1:n
                if !visited[k]
                    floor_cost = (pz[k] == dz[prev]) ? 0.0 : 50.0
                    time_wait = max(0.0, ep[k] - ld[prev])
                    dist = sqrt((px[k] - dx[prev])^2 + (py[k] - dy[prev])^2)
                    cost = floor_cost + 0.5 * time_wait + dist + rand(params.rng) * 0.1

                    if cost < best_cost
                        best_cost = cost
                        best_k = k
                    end
                end
            end

            order[step] = best_k
            visited[best_k] = true
        end

        result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[order[k]])
        end
        return result
    end
end
